slides.texte_overlay:
green flags you're becoming
smarter without noticing

you say i don't know

you've stopped pretending to know things and started saying i don't know, let me check. that's not weakness, it's the first sign of a genuinely curious mind.

you enjoy being wrong

being corrected feels less like losing and more like learning. people who grow fastest are the ones who stopped needing to be right in every conversation.

you get bored of gossip

conversations about other people bore you more than they used to. a mind full of ideas gets restless when the talk is only about who did what to whom.

you crave learning

you look forward to 5 minutes of learning more than 5 minutes of scrolling: a painting, a planet, a moment in history. that shift is the clearest sign of all.
slides.texte_sophia:
you crave learning

i noticed i look forward to my 5 minute lesson in the Sophia app more than to scrolling: a painting, a planet, a moment in history. that shift says everything.

slides.texte_overlay:
you ask better questions

your questions got shorter and sharper. good questions are a sign you understand enough to know exactly what you're missing, and that's real intelligence.
